'''Kamarian''' is an extinct [[Austronesian language]]. It was spoken at the southwestern coast of [[Seram Island]] in the [[Moluccas]] in eastern [[Indonesia]].<ref>Collins, James T. (1983). [https://dx.doi.org/10.15144/PL-D47 ''The Historical Relationships of the Languages of Central Maluku, Indonesia.''] Canberra: Pacific Linguistics.</ref>
